earnings.title: DoorDash Releases Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
highlights: GAAP net income attributable to DoorDash, Inc. common stockholders increased 91% Y/Y to $466 million.
GAAP net income attributable to DoorDash, Inc. common stockholders $ 244 $ 213 $ 184 $ 200 $ 466
outlook: We expect to invest more than 100% of total synergies in the first year after close, followed by positive net synergies in year two and beyond.
2026 stock-based compensation expense of approximately $1.2 billion.
2026 depreciation and amortization expense of approximately $1.2 billion, inclusive of approximately $450 million of amortization of acquired intangible assets.

items.heading: We expect our results of operations to fluctuate on a quarterly and annual basis due to a number of factors, which may make it difficult to predict our future performance.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: We have a history of net losses, we anticipate increasing expenses in the future, and we may not be able to consistently maintain or increase profitability in the future.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: Our business may not continue to grow on pace with historical rates.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: We face intense competition and if we are unable to compete effectively, our business, financial condition, and results of operations could be adversely affected.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: If we fail to retain our existing merchants and consumers or acquire new merchants and consumers in a cost-effective manner, our revenue, revenue growth, and margins may decrease and our business, financial condition, and results of operations could be adversely affected.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: If we fail to cost-effectively attract and retain Dashers or to increase the use of our platform by existing Dashers, our business, financial condition, and results of operations could be adversely affected.
